Four teammates faced a farm café brief, and Hana and Jack first pushed for chickens. Sofia pointed out the client's rule: no animals people eat. Omar wanted a cat, but with the sketch already done, he agreed to donkey: "Aligned on donkey!"

Jack traced the start and carried the back line toward the neck, but a jam just before his work left everything past it cut off from the start. Hana spotted the dip near the front, closed the gap, and reconnected the line. Sofia took the neck and head curve while Omar was still on the back line. The ears stayed unconnected until Sofia and Hana tied them into the neck line. Omar fixed the belly, Jack bridged the head-to-belly gap, and with the clock nearly out, hands came off the table.

When the start was pushed, 169 of 223 fell. Everyone named a donkey, but the blind judges guessed horse, dog, and deer.
